title: Logic Test: Can You Score 9/9?

script:
Only 7% of people correctly answer all nine questions on this logic test.
Question 1: What has an eye but cannot see?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: A needle.
Question 2: What is always in front of you but can’t be seen?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: The future.
Question 3: A doctor's son is your father, but the doctor is not your father. Who is the doctor?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: Your mother.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: What has cities, but no houses; forests, but no trees; and water, but no fish?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: A map.
Question 5: Before Mount Everest was discovered, what was the highest mountain in the world?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Mount Everest.
How many did you get right so far? Comment your score.
Question 6: What two things can you never eat for breakfast?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Lunch and dinner.
Question 7: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: An echo.
Question 8: Which letter of the alphabet has the most water?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: The letter C (sea).
Are you ready for the last question? Can you join the elite 7%? The leaderboard is updated weekly!
Question 9: If you have a 3-gallon and a 5-gallon jug, how do you measure exactly 4 gallons?
Lock in your answer: Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Fill 5-gallon, pour into 3-gallon (2 left in 5-gallon), empty 3-gallon, pour 2-gallons into 3-gallon, fill 5-gallon, top off 3-gallon (1 gallon to fill), 4 gallons left in 5-gallon.
Share your final score and follow for more brain teasers!
